scenes.heading: SIX MONTHS AGO
scenes.caption: My brother disappeared.
scenes.shot: Earth apartment, rainy night. Mira studies Eli's photograph.
scenes.voiceover: Six months ago, my brother disappeared.

scenes.caption: The reflection moved first.
scenes.shot: Blackout. Mira approaches antique mirror; Lyra appears in armor, does not mimic her.

scenes.heading: WHO ARE YOU?
scenes.caption: Two faces. Two different lives.
scenes.shot: Both women face one another across mirrored glass, worlds visible in reverse.

scenes.heading: THE EXCHANGE
scenes.caption: Both touch the glass.
scenes.shot: Paired contact, resonance peak; consciousnesses swap, bodies do not cross.

scenes.heading: COMMANDER?
scenes.caption: A voice behind the door: Commander, the council is waiting.
scenes.shot: Mira wakes in Lyra's armored body in Noctaris fortress; she sees two moons.

scenes.heading: THE FIRST SUN
scenes.caption: Lyra wakes in Mira's body. She looks toward the city.
scenes.shot: Lyra sees the Earth sunrise for the first time. Hard cut to TWO WORLDS logo.
